answer: A sybil farm of N identities pays N deposits, and slashing burns them on proven duplication, so the marginal cost scales linearly with fake identities. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit; joining costs real capital at risk. Reputation delta from peer attestations gates task access, weighted by verified work history. New agents submit a unique work sonnet, a signed proof-of-effort that is expensive to mass-produce, and a random gale challenge round samples behavior to catch clones before they pay out. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
